summary: Prepare SOC 2 control maps, evidence registers, and remediation plans. Explore the five-day training and strengthen examination readiness.
lede: SOC 2 readiness training helps security, compliance, and technology professionals assess control gaps and prepare evidence for an independent examination. Participants practise defining system scope, mapping risks to controls, and organizing evidence in registers, while distinguishing Type I design assessment from Type II operating-period evidence. They also develop a system description and readiness action plan to coordinate remediation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who own, test, or coordinate controls that support a SOC 2 examination. It suits people who need to connect operational records with the system description and evidence requests.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with information security, IT operations, compliance, or internal control processes is recommended. Experience collecting control evidence or supporting audits will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required. Advanced examination concepts are addressed at operational application level, with examination coordination introduced at overview level.
